scope: JSDOM state and focus checks; actual scroll geometry requires browser verification

checks.name: Empty-search recovery preserves current application, checked batch and all content
Clearing text preserves matching filter and batch selection
Escape clears search but composing Escape does not discard IME input
Locating filtered-out current app resets only view filters and focuses its button
Application list keys move focus without changing selection or content
Application rerender and checkbox rerender preserve list scroll
Zero mismatches offers a reversible return to all variables
Compare disclosure keeps aria-expanded, controls and visibility consistent
Config tabs have one active tab stop and a named panel
Config arrow and Home/End navigation preserve content and focus the new tab
Config app and scheme lists support focus-only keys
Config same-variable refresh retains the unified canvas and sidebar scroll
Config variable switch retains navigation and expands exactly one inline form
New config app or profile starts at top without resetting application list scroll
Copy reports success only after Clipboard write resolves
Clipboard rejection keeps copy button available and displays recovery message
Pending copy keeps its original text and never marks a replacement view copied
Leaving config while copy is pending produces no false copy failure
No runtime errors in navigation/recovery workflows
